sprint.name: CourtHive Bundle - Club Championships in the Box
sprint.goal: Ship CourtHive (tournament server, TMX tournament management, and the public tournament pages) as an opt-in part of the package, so a club that installs jim-dot-tennis can also run its own club championships on its own server, with its own accounts and secrets, without building anything or knowing how the pieces fit.
focus_areas: Published, club-neutral images of the three CourtHive components
One opt-in switch that brings up the tournament stack on the club's own server
Per-instance provisioning: the club's own provider, administrator and secrets
Upgrades and backups that include the tournament data
